issues.detail: The Hebrew text says 'Elisha sent a messenger to him' (וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח אֵלָ֛יו אֱלִישָׁ֖ע מַלְאָ֣ךְ), but the Vietnamese adds 'Đức Chúa Trời' (God) as the subject, making it 'God sent Elisha sent a messenger' — an addition of a subject not present in the Hebrew, which changes who is doing the sending.
